title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #23 (대각 띠 3구역·물결 / 세로 띠 3구역·물결 / 동심원 3구역·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Turkish woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, bold and confident, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 38% of the way down her figure from the top and about 67% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform lace-up sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, bold and confident, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 36% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 69% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: needle heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, cool and composed, sleek silver-grey hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes. Long round nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 53% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 41% and 63% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, with spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
